Goal of this script is to perform a  exact test, by site, for the made psychosis_merged phenotype here then graph it

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forestplot)
library(kableExtra)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

data <- read.csv("~/work/khat_gwas/script_referenced_files/mary_tables_NeuroGAP.translated.patient.response.asof.09-21-23.csv")

View(data)
```

```{r}

# Ensure psychosis_merged is created before filtering
data <- data %>%
  mutate(psychosis_merged = case_when(
    psychosis_primary %in% c("Bipolar", "Mania NOS") ~ "Bipolar",
    psychosis_primary %in% c("Schizophrenia", "Psychotic Disorder NOS", "Schizoaffective Disorder") ~ "Schizophrenia",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

# Map hub_site to new hub_location names
data <- data %>%
  mutate(hub_location = case_when(
    hub_site %in% c("Cape Town", "Walter Sisulu") ~ "South Africa/UCT",
    hub_site == "Addis Ababa" ~ "Ethiopia",
    hub_site == "Moi" ~ "Kenya: Moi",
    hub_site == "KEMRI" ~ "Kenya: KEMRI",
    hub_site == "Makerere" ~ "Uganda",
    TRUE ~ hub_site  # Retain all other locations
  ))

# Define unique hub locations
hub_locations <- unique(data$hub_location)

# Define psychosis categories
psychosis_categories <- c("Bipolar", "Schizophrenia") 

# Initialize results dataframe for Fisher's test
results <- data.frame(
  Hub_Location = character(), 
  Psychosis = character(), 
  P_Value = numeric(), 
  OR = numeric(), 
  CI_Lower = numeric(), 
  CI_Upper = numeric(), 
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Initialize contingency table dataframe
contingency_summary <- data.frame(
  Hub_Location = character(),
  Psychosis = character(),
  Status = character(),
  No_Khat_Use = integer(),
  Khat_Use = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop through each hub location and psychosis category
for (hub in hub_locations) {
  for (psychosis in psychosis_categories) {
    
    # Subset data for the current hub location and filter out `other_psych_yn == 1` or NA
    subset_data <- data %>% 
      dplyr::filter(hub_location == hub, other_psych_yn == 0)  # Exclude NA and 1 in other_psych_yn
    
    # Skip if no data remains after filtering
    if (nrow(subset_data) == 0 || !"psychosis_merged" %in% colnames(subset_data)) {
      next
    }

    # Define cases and controls correctly
    subset_data <- subset_data %>%
      mutate(
        psychosis_binary = case_when(
          psychosis_merged == psychosis ~ "Case",  # Case = has the current psychosis
          TRUE ~ "Control"  # Control = does not have the psychosis (other psychosis or NA)
        ),
        assist_khat_label = ifelse(assist_khat == 1, "Khat Use", "No Khat Use") # Label khat use
      )

    # Create contingency table
    contingency_table <- table(subset_data$assist_khat_label, subset_data$psychosis_binary)
    
    # Save counts in contingency summary table
    if (all(dim(contingency_table) == c(2,2))) {
      contingency_summary <- rbind(contingency_summary, data.frame(
        Hub_Location = hub,
        Psychosis = psychosis,
        Status = "Control",
        No_Khat_Use = contingency_table["No Khat Use", "Control"],
        Khat_Use = contingency_table["Khat Use", "Control"]
      ))
      
      contingency_summary <- rbind(contingency_summary, data.frame(
        Hub_Location = hub,
        Psychosis = psychosis,
        Status = "Case",
        No_Khat_Use = contingency_table["No Khat Use", "Case"],
        Khat_Use = contingency_table["Khat Use", "Case"]
      ))
      
      # Perform Fisher's exact test
      fisher_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
      p_value <- fisher_result$p.value
      OR <- fisher_result$estimate  # Odds ratio
      CI_Lower <- fisher_result$conf.int[1]  # Lower bound of confidence interval
      CI_Upper <- fisher_result$conf.int[2]  # Upper bound of confidence interval
    } else {
      p_value <- NA
      OR <- NA
      CI_Lower <- NA
      CI_Upper <- NA
    }
    
    # Store Fisher's test results
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Hub_Location = hub, 
      Psychosis = psychosis, 
      P_Value = p_value, 
      OR = OR, 
      CI_Lower = CI_Lower, 
      CI_Upper = CI_Upper
    ))
  }
}

# Display contingency table
kable(contingency_summary, caption = "Khat Use and Primary Psychosis Phenotypes") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

# Save contingency table as CSV
write.csv(contingency_summary, "contingency_summary_filtered.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Filter out NAs from Fisher's test results
results_filtered <- results %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(OR))

# Format hub-psychosis labels
results_filtered <- results_filtered %>%
  mutate(Label = paste(Hub_Location, Psychosis, sep = " - "))

# Order labels for better visualization
results_filtered$Label <- factor(results_filtered$Label, levels = results_filtered$Label[order(results_filtered$OR)])

# Create the forest plot
forest_plot <- ggplot(results_filtered, aes(x = Label, y = OR)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the OR point
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_Lower, ymax = CI_Upper), width = 0.2) +  # Add confidence intervals
  scale_y_log10() +  # Log scale for odds ratio
  coord_flip() +  # Flip axes for readability
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Khat Use and Primary Psychosis phenotypes",
       x = "Hub Location - Psychosis Category", 
       y = "Odds Ratio (Log Scale)") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")  # Reference line at OR = 1

# Save forest plot
ggsave("forest_plot_filtered.png", forest_plot, width = 10, height = 6)

# Display the forest plot
print(forest_plot)

```


```{r}

# Display OR and full p-values, ordered from highest to lowest OR
results_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(Hub_Location, Psychosis, OR, P_Value) %>%
  arrange(desc(OR)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Odds Ratios and Full P-values for Khat Use by Psychosis and Hub Location (Ordered by OR)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)


```

```{r}
# Print just the p-values for each disease at each site to console
results_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(Hub_Location, Psychosis, P_Value) %>%
  arrange(Psychosis, Hub_Location) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
setwd("~/work/khat_gwas/phenotype_files")

# Define function
get_khat_use_percentage <- function(df, site_name) {
  total <- sum(!is.na(df$assist_khat))
  khat_users <- sum(df$assist_khat == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  percent <- (khat_users / total) * 100

  cat(sprintf(
    "%s: %.2f%% (n = %d of %d)\n",
    site_name, percent, khat_users, total
  ))
}

# Files and corresponding site names
files <- c(
  "AAU_khat_pheno.txt",
  "KEMRI_khat_pheno.txt",
  "Moi_khat_pheno.txt",
  "UCT_khat_pheno.txt",
  "Uganda_khat_pheno.txt"
)

sites <- c(
  "AAU",
  "KEMRI",
  "Moi",
  "UCT",
  "Uganda"
)

# Read each file and calculate khat-use percentage
for (i in seq_along(files)) {

  df <- read.table(
    files[i],
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  get_khat_use_percentage(df, sites[i])
}

```

```{r}
# Directory containing phenotype files
dir_path <- "~/work/khat_gwas/phenotype_files"

# File names
files <- c(
  "AAU_khat_pheno.txt",
  "KEMRI_khat_pheno.txt",
  "Moi_khat_pheno.txt",
  "UCT_khat_pheno.txt",

)

# Site names
sites <- c(
  "AAU",
  "KEMRI",
  "Moi",
  "UCT",
  "Uganda"
)

# Helper function
print_khat_amt_distribution <- function(df, site_name) {
  cat("\n---", site_name, "---\n")
  print(table(df$assist_khat_amt, useNA = "ifany"))
}

# Read each file and print distribution
for (i in seq_along(files)) {

  df <- read.table(
    file.path(dir_path, files[i]),
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  print_khat_amt_distribution(df, sites[i])
}
```
